architecture.mechanism: Real-time parameter acquisition and automatic device control based on sensor data
architecture.intervention: Integrate an ESP32-based monitoring module into the transmission control unit to sample gear shift timing, hydraulic pressure, and engine torque at 2-second intervals, enabling real-time software adjustments to shift solenoids and throttle mapping to prevent hesitation and clunking.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of gear-change hesitation and clunking while maintaining full engine power by dynamically correcting shift parameters before mechanical disruption occurs.
architecture.falsification_test: Install the monitoring module on a test vehicle exhibiting the failure, induce idle conditions, and verify that the system fails to reduce shift latency or prevent clunking events within the first 500 miles despite active data transmission and control loop engagement.
